research.title: Annexe:Faux-amis anglais-français
research.note: The false-friends list behind the Faux Amis game and the false-friend badge on farm plots, read live in the browser each time it is used and named on screen.

inspiration.title: SM-2 spaced repetition
inspiration.note: The watering schedule is a lightweight SM-2-style scheduler: an ease factor, intervals that grow after each correct recall and a reset to one day after a miss.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.

other.title: FREN151 and FREN152 course workbook and lecture slides
other.note: The farm's words, grammar points and their order come from the workbook, cross-checked against the teacher's own lecture slides for FREN151 and for FREN152 weeks 1 to 7 plus week 13.
